sections.title: 🎯 What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Passing arrays to methods lets you work with whole collections of data at once - no more copying values one by one!

• How to send an entire array to a method
• Why arrays are passed differently than single variables
• Practical examples you can use right away

sections.title: 💡 Concept Explanation
sections.content:
Imagine you're moving houses. Instead of carrying each book one by one, you pack them all in a box and hand the whole box to your friend. That's exactly how passing arrays to methods works!

When you pass an array to a method, you're giving the method access to the entire 'box' of values at once. The method can then read or modify any element inside.

• Arrays are passed by reference (they point to the same memory location)
• This means changes inside the method affect the original array
• It's super efficient - no need to copy all the data

sections.title: ⚡ Key Points
points: ✓ Arrays are passed by reference - methods work with the original array
✓ Changes made inside the method affect the original array
✓ No need to return the array - modifications are automatic
✓ Method parameters use array type syntax: `int[] arr`
✓ This is different from primitive types which are passed by value

sections.title: 🔥 Tips & Mistakes
dos: Use descriptive parameter names like `int[] scores` instead of `int[] arr`
Check for null arrays before working with them
Document whether your method modifies the input array
donts: Don't assume the array has a specific length
Don't forget arrays can be null
Don't try to return the array - it's already modified
sections.protip: If you want to preserve the original array, create a copy before passing it to methods that modify arrays

sections.title: 🌍 Real World Use
sections.content: Where is Passing Arrays to Methods used in real apps?

examples.how: Pass arrays of sensor data to methods that calculate averages, find peaks, or detect anomalies
Pass arrays of game objects to methods that update positions, check collisions, or render graphics
Pass arrays of transaction data to methods that calculate totals, apply fees, or generate reports

problem.description: Write a method called `reverseArray` that takes an integer array and reverses its elements. The method should modify the original array (no need to return anything).
hints: You'll need to swap elements from the start and end moving towards the center
Use a temporary variable to help with swapping
Only need to loop through half the array
problem.explanation: The method swaps the first element with the last, the second with the second-last, and so on until it reaches the middle. This efficiently reverses the array in place.

sections.title: 📝 Summary
points: 📌 Arrays are passed to methods by reference - changes affect the original
📌 Method parameters use array syntax: `type[] parameterName`
📌 Practice by writing methods that modify arrays in place
📌 You're ready to learn about returning arrays from methods next!
